senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (लोठति)
To knock down.
(लोठते)
To resist or oppose.
r. 6th cl. (लुठति)
To be connected or in contact with, to rest in or on.
r. 1st and 6th cls. (लोठते लुठति)
1 To roll on the ground.
2 To flow, to trickle.
r. 10th cl. (लोठयति)
To rob.
(इ) लुठि r. 1st cl. (लुण्ठति)
1 To be lazy.
2 To repel, to resist or oppose.
3 To go, to move.
4 To steal.
5 To be lame.

mfn. (-ठन्-ठन्ती-ठत्)
1 Rolling on the ground, falling down.
2 Flowing, trickling.
E.
लुठ to roll, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 A horse's rolling himself on the ground.
2 Rolling on the ground with sorrow or vexation, &c.
E.
लुट or लुठ to cast one's self on the ground, aff. क्युच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rolling on the ground, (as a horse, &c.)
m. (-तः)
A horse rolling himself on the ground, &c.
E.
लुठ to roll on the ground, aff. क्त.
